queries.group consecutive tokens into semantic c: grouping consecutive tokens into semantic chunks of fixed size for KV cache compression preserving contextual relationships in long-context LLM inference
queries.Calculate observation scores for chunks: semantic chunk KV cache compression using aggregated attention observation scores computed by summing token attention within chunks to retain important semantic units in long-context LLM inference
queries.Select the top-k chunks based on these a: KV cache compression selecting top-k semantic chunks by summing attention scores within chunks under a fixed cache budget for long-context LLM inference
queries.Preserve the sequential order of selecte: preserving sequential order of selected chunks in KV cache compression to maintain narrative flow and temporal structure for long-context reasoning and multi-document question answering in large language models
queries.Concatenate an observation window to ret: KV cache compression for long-context LLM inference that concatenates a recent observation window with selected semantic chunks to preserve recency-sensitive context and maintain recent tokens during chunk-based key-value cache selection
queries.computing chunk selection only for every: Efficient KV cache compression for long-context LLM inference using semantic chunk selection with layer-wise index reuse, computing chunk indices only every Nth layer and reusing them for intermediate layers to reduce repeated selection overhead.
queries.implement ChunkKV as a drop-in replaceme: Drop-in replacement of existing key-value cache compression methods with semantic chunking in transformer inference stacks, enabling deployment without architectural changes to current LLM architectures
queries.evaluate ChunkKV on LongBench and Needle: KV cache compression preserving semantic chunks for long-context LLM inference evaluated on LongBench and Needle-In-A-Haystack with LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct, and Qwen2-7B-Instruct for question answering, retrieval, and multi-document comprehension
queries.evaluate across 17 datasets covering sin: ChunkKV semantic-preserving KV cache compression evaluated on LongBench across single-document QA, multi-document QA, summarization, few-shot learning, and synthetic long-context tasks
queries.test retrieval capabilities across conte: ChunkKV semantic chunk KV cache compression retrieval evaluation on Needle-in-a-Haystack at 8k and 32k token contexts for long-context LLM inference
queries.test compression ratios of 10%, 20%, and: Evaluate semantic chunk-based KV cache compression for long-context LLM inference by measuring accuracy, memory usage, compression trade-offs at 10%, 20%, 30% compression ratios on LongBench, Needle-In-A-Haystack benchmarks.
queries.compare ChunkKV against existing methods: Comparative evaluation of ChunkKV semantic chunk KV cache compression against StreamingLLM H2O SnapKV PyramidKV token-level KV compression baselines under identical long-context LLM inference settings, compression ratios, attention score selection, memory usage, and task performance.
queries.measure both task performance and comput: Evaluate semantic-preserving KV cache compression for long-context LLM inference by measuring task performance and computational efficiency, including compression time, memory usage, and accuracy on long-context benchmarks, to determine whether preserving semantic chunks improves accuracy without sacrificing efficiency gains compared with token-level KV cache compression methods.
queries.conduct systematic ablation studies to d: Ablation study of ChunkKV semantic chunk-based KV cache compression for long-context LLM inference, evaluating chunk sizes from one to thirty tokens, layer-wise index reuse across multiple reuse layers, and trade-offs between compression efficiency and task performance degradation.
queries.quantify the semantic preservation capab: Evaluate semantic preservation in chunk-based KV cache compression for long-context LLM inference by measuring layer-wise Jaccard similarity of preserved chunk indices and comparing attention pattern retention against discrete token-level compression methods.
queries.assess ChunkKV's effectiveness on GSM8K: KV cache compression preserving semantic chunks for LLM in-context learning, evaluated on GSM8K arithmetic reasoning with chain-of-thought prompts at 30 percent compression, maintaining multi-step reasoning chains in long-context inference
queries.evaluate performance across multiple lan: Cross-lingual evaluation of semantic chunking KV cache compression for long-context LLM inference using Qwen2-7B-Instruct on Chinese subtasks to assess generalization beyond English-centric tasks
queries.All experiments will be conducted three: Three repeated benchmark runs reporting mean scores to reduce variance, ensure statistical robustness, support reliable comparison of long-context LLM KV cache compression methods
